en.title: Most Unique Elements
en.description:
Select the least concentrated strings by the ratio of each string's highest character frequency, then keep only the characters that appear only in the selected set. The source's only example determines the return rule; this site adds the input protocol.

The company source is still Unknown; the input protocol added by this site does not represent the I/O of the original OAMaster problem.
en.input: The first line contains n (1≤n≤1000), followed by n lines of non-empty strings containing only lowercase English letters, each of length 1..1000.
en.output: First select all strings with the smallest ratio of the most common character; output the characters in these strings that do not appear in any unselected string, keeping repeated characters in the original input order of the selected strings and their order within each string.
en.explanation: See the accompanying notes for details.
hints: Ratios can be compared with integer cross-multiplication; keep all tied strings.
